brief.zh: 不用假设框，由「下雨」证出「刮风 → 下雨」。
brief.en: Without the assumption box, prove “it is windy → it rains” from “it rains”.

hint.zh: K 的元件上第一句选「下雨」、第二句选「刮风」，再把它套用到已知上。
hint.en: Choose “it rains” and “it is windy” on K’s part, then apply it to the given.

t.zh: 这个专题把框拿走，只剩套用和你证出的 K、S。早期的证明器（希尔伯特系统）就是这样：只有一条规则和几条公理。
t.en: This topic takes the box away, leaving Apply and the K and S you proved. Early provers (Hilbert systems) were like this: one rule and a few axioms.

t.zh: 要给一句话加条件，框做不了，就得找一句现成的「如果…那么…」来套用。
t.en: To put a condition on a sentence without a box, find a ready-made “if … then …” to apply.

after.zh: 有框时一个框，没有框要 K 加一次套用。
after.en: One box with a box; without it, K and an Apply.
